October 1, 2025

# New: Support for USDC Credit field in Shopify Payments Payout GraphQL

DateOctober 1, 2025

Version[2025-10](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-10)

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

As of GraphQL Admin API version **2025-10**, `ShopifyPaymentsPayoutSummary` now includes a `usdcRebateCreditAmount` field, which provides a total of all USDC rebate credits issued as part of the payout.

For more information about `ShopifyPaymentsPayoutSummary`, visit the [Shopify.dev documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-10/objects/shopifypaymentspayoutsummary).
